newsitem.title: CANADA: DBRS rates EdperBrascan at BBB (high), R-1 (low).
newsitem.headline: DBRS rates EdperBrascan at BBB (high), R-1 (low).

text.p: Dominion Bond Rating Agency said on Friday it assigned ratings of BBB (high), Pfd-3 and R-1 (low) to EdperBrascan Corp.
EdperBrascan is the company to be created by the proposed merger of Edper Group Ltd and Brascan Ltd, which is set to take effect on August 1.
The Toronto-based bond rating agency said the new ratings will apply to all previously issued debt and preferred shares of Edper and Brascan, as well as future new issues.

DBRS said the ratings are based on the merger receiving shareholder approval with little change to the terms and conditions described in the June 6 offering circular. After the merger Edper and Brascan's ratings would be discontinued.

Since the merger would combine Edper's and Brascan's assets and liabilities without separation, DBRS said there would be greater cash flow diversity, a broader asset base containing a large portion of liquid assets and a more streamlined organizational structure.
